text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's summer, and we're discussing how to train for the Kikuka Sho on a beach near camp…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! I'm really fretting here! Honestly, I don't know how much help I can be to Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Greetings, Ryan. How reassuring to have you here. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Nah, my poses might be empowering, but I'm real anxious over here…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If you're looking for an edge in medium-distance races, I'm your gal. But those long races? And especially those 3000-meter ones? I don't think I've got the stuff…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Me? Geez, I'd be even less help than Ryan. I've been on a break since I won the Derby, and I've never run in a longer race before either.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If you're looking for someone to coach Bright for the Kikuka Sho, there's definitely a better candidate out there. Think about it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Just leave the rest to her! Do your best out there, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess she's right… There's someone else who's way better equipped for long-distance training than Ines and I would be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Bright. How about betting on you-know-who? The Mejiro family boasts all kinds of Umamusume, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When the race you're aiming for changes, it's best to switch to a coach who knows that race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to come up with a new training regimen that'll put us in good stead to take on the challenges of the fall season.
